question: How do I speak at a city council meeting?

nuggets.text: Council meetings are open to the public.
nuggets.quote: All meetings of public bodies shall be open, except as provided in §§ 2.2-3707.01 and 2.2-3711 .

nuggets.text: Anyone may photograph, film or record an open meeting.
nuggets.quote: Any person may photograph, film, record, or otherwise reproduce any portion of a meeting required to be open.

notes: The right to speak is set by the council's own rules; state law only opens the meeting.
